mechanism: Mefloquine can cause hyperglycemia and impair glucose control, potentially reducing dapagliflozin efficacy, while dapagliflozin increases risk of euglycemic DKA which may be masked by mefloquine's neuropsychiatric effects.
action: Monitor blood glucose closely during mefloquine therapy; consider alternative antimalarial if possible; educate patient on DKA symptoms regardless of glucose levels.
